title: Orvan grain corridor renewed for a second year

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor
facts.statement: Orvan and its grain buyers have renewed the Corridor Agreement for a second year, according to people involved in the talks.

source_ref.text_snippet: Orvan and its grain buyers have renewed the Corridor Agreement for a second year, according to people involved in the talks.

facts.subject: Wheat offers for Orvan cargoes
facts.statement: Wheat offers for Orvan cargoes eased on the report.

source_ref.text_snippet: Wheat offers for Orvan cargoes eased on the report.

validation_notes: Citation repaired: quote found in ¶7, not cited ¶6

flagged_facts.subject: sea exports
flagged_facts.statement: The renewal would keep sea exports at about 95% of the old normal.

source_ref.text_snippet: The renewal would keep sea exports at about 95% of the old normal.

validation_notes: Verifier: statement only partially supported. Numeric value of 95% is stated as 'about 95%', which is a hedge that is missing in the statement.
